\begin{lexlean}{Main}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.0.0}
\useglossary{test.probe@1.0.0}
\title{Natural number addition}

\begin{theorem}{add-zero}
\noaxioms
For every natural number \(n\), \(n + 0 = n\).
\begin{proof}
Close the goal by reflexivity.
\end{proof}
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}{is-zero}
\noaxioms
\(iszero(0)\).
\begin{proof}
Close the goal by reflexivity.
\end{proof}
\end{theorem}
\end{lexlean}
